pollster.weighting_quote: Data was weighted to population proportions by respondent gender, age, Alaska region, marital status, education level, party affiliation, political ideology and 2024 vote for president. / A further weight was then overlaid on the voter sample, initially anchoring results to a Trump-Harris 2024 vote ratio, with a general election voter distribution by gender, age and AK region.
